limits: Complete two-emitter Q_Cas only; Q_End/distortion and other systems remain separate.
Raw frame-rate hash remains in source. Atlas random start plus local age-times-rate seek is an explicit local adapter, not a native update/RNG certificate.

Accepted Q and actor-root attachment, source-X reflection, first-update grid, cosmetic hashes and shader defaults are local reconstruction policies. Cast particles remain independent of body untargetability/hiding.
Source particle linger values remain retained without extending finite visible lives. Existing Q audio dispatch owns the on-create sound; this renderer adds no duplicate sound.
